Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Web User Experience Specialist position at Cronos Europa. With a unique blend of technical web development skills and a strong focus on user experience, I am confident in my ability to support the SERVE Unit in enhancing service quality and user satisfaction.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have gained hands-on experience in managing websites with a focus on user experience. I build and maintain WordPress sites using Elementor and Astra, ensuring responsive design and intuitive navigation. I also conduct on-page SEO and create keyword-targeted content that engages users and improves search visibility. My work involves analyzing performance data from tools like Google Analytics, Search Console, and SEMrush to identify areas for improvement and make data-driven decisions.

My personal project, mirook.com, further demonstrates my commitment to UX and data analysis. I designed and built the site from scratch, implementing structured data and technical SEO/GEO audits to enhance visibility across search engines. This project honed my ability to collect and interpret data, create compelling visuals, and maintain an organized web presence.

I am particularly drawn to this role because it emphasizes improving user experience and transparency of IT services. My background in digital communication and web environments, combined with my analytical skills, makes me well-suited to create clear materials, prepare reports, and perform user acceptance testing. I am comfortable interacting with stakeholders at all levels and thrive in collaborative, customer-centric environments.

I am eager to bring my skills in web UX, data analysis, and visual communication to Cronos Europa and contribute to the success of the SERVE Unit. Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can support your team.

Sincerely,

Baver Ok
Digital Marketing · SEO · GEO · Content · Web
Zwijndrecht, Belgium | +32 470 42 48 36 | baverok@gmail.com | linkedin.com/in/baverok

## Profile
Junior digital marketer with a technical foundation in web design, SEO, and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization). At Episto, I run on-page SEO, keyword-targeted content, and full-cycle WordPress site build and maintenance for client sites. On my own project (mirook.com) I've applied structured data, entity optimization, and technical SEO/GEO audits to improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. Comfortable across content management, social media coordination, and performance reporting; quick to pick up new tools and platforms, and growing into analytics, e-commerce content management, and campaign support. Based in Zwijndrecht, next to Antwerp. Works in English and Turkish; Dutch: B1, currently taking classes to improve further.

## Core Skills
- Website management with a focus on user experience: WordPress, Elementor, Astra theme, responsive web design
- Analytical and reporting: Google Analytics, Google Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Ads
- Visual communication and storytelling: Canva, AI-assisted content tools, SEO blog & content writing
- Data analysis and structuring: technical SEO audits, structured data / JSON-LD schema, entity optimization
- Digital communication: social media content & integration, editorial content publishing
- Languages: English (professional), Turkish (native), Dutch (B1)

- Own on-page SEO for client websites, from keyword research to publishing, improving organic visibility and search rankings
- Write keyword-targeted blog content for client websites to grow organic traffic
- Build and maintain client websites in WordPress using Elementor and the Astra theme, including content uploads and page updates
- Track site performance with SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and Google Ads to guide SEO and content decisions

### Warehouse & Logistics — Katoen Natie (Antwerp), 2025–2026
- Maintained accuracy and efficiency in a high-volume, fast-paced logistics environment

### Front-End Developer — ViviDoctor (Belgium), 2018–2019
- Developed and optimized front-end features for a healthcare web application (AngularJS, JavaScript)

## Projects

### mirook.com — Website Design, SEO & GEO (2025–present)
- Designed and built a multi-page WordPress site (Elementor, Astra) for a Belgian youth chess champion: full site structure, on-page SEO, and social media integration (Instagram/Facebook)
- Implemented structured data (JSON-LD schema, including SportsEvent and FAQPage), entity/knowledge-graph markup, and an llms.txt file to improve visibility across traditional and AI-powered search engines (GEO/AEO)
- Ran iterative technical SEO/GEO audits, measurably raising the site's overall search-health score
